generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Classify the request as implementation, full specification or research, and select the corresponding lane, output variant, priority and acceptance profile.

contract.purpose_user_function: Classify incoming intent and choose implementation/specification/research compilation behavior.
contract.valid_inputs: Raw request text plus configured/learned intent rules, markers, task taxonomy, and optional source artifact.
contract.expected_outputs: Mode/intent matches with confidence/rationale and selected requirement/output lane.
contract.state_side_effects: May record intent-match feedback/events and capture intake artifacts.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: No credible match, contradictory markers, negated action, or malformed configured rule yields unknown/default/needs-review rather than unsafe dispatch.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Deterministic heuristics/rules are shipped; classification quality is language/marker dependent.
contract.success_evidence: Output records selected mode and rationale; test_intent_gateway.py covers representative mode and negation cases.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: implementation; research; strategy/spec; negation; conflicting markers; unknown; configured/learned rule.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow; docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §§1 and 5; docs/UNIFIED_ORCHESTRATOR_DESIGN.md §2.1 Intent parser
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: infer_mode(), deterministic_rewrite(), build_requirement_ir(), capture(); harness/lib/intent_engine_adapter.py: match(), learn(), main()
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/intent_gateway.py: infer_mode(); harness/lib/intent_engine_adapter.py: match_static(), match_configured(), match_learned(), match()
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Deterministic matching is local; optional model rewriting depends on configured model access. Natural-language completeness and clarification policy remain partly heuristic.
